quizzes.backend_description: Shows a number line from -10 to 10 with tick marks and labels. A red marker shows the starting position at -2.
solution_image_tag: Shows a number line from -10 to 10 with a red marker at the starting position -2 and a green marker at the final result 3.
solution: We are adding -2 + 5 using a number line.
Start at -2 on the number line.
Move 5 units to the right to add 5.
We end up at 3 on the number line.
Therefore, -2 + 5 = 3.
